items.title: UE6ではブループリントを最初から廃止へ。AIの生産性を優先した方針転換を，Tim Sweeney氏が謝罪とともに明かした「Unreal Fest Tokyo 2026」基調講演
items.excerpt: At Unreal Fest Tokyo 2026 Tim Sweeney said Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints from the start rather than phase them out, prioritising AI-agent productivity, and apologised for the change.
items.note: off-list (4Gamer, JP); engine tooling shift driven by AI; distinct from 10-29 Eurogamer 'Epic no longer writing code'

items.title: Power Moon Recomp: unofficial native PC port of Super Mario Odyssey built with Claude coding agent (AI로 만든 PC판 4K '마리오 오디세이' 눈길)
items.excerpt: An unofficial static-recompilation port runs Super Mario Odyssey natively on PC at up to 4K/60fps; the developer says it was built with heavy help from the Claude AI coding agent, shipping seven versions in about 30 hours.

items.title: 50体のAIに『マインクラフト』で文明づくりさせたらどうなるか。“ビビリお役所仕事集団”が誕生した
items.excerpt: Y Combinator and Olam Labs published 'Agents in Games', a study letting 50 AI agents build a civilisation in Minecraft; the agents formed a timid, bureaucratic society.
items.note: off-list (JP); multi-agent AI behaviour in games research

items.title: AI製ゲーム激増のitch.ioにて「AIフィルター」実装。AI使用の「ある/なし」以外に、“どこで使ったか”もフィルタリング
items.excerpt: itch.io shipped AI search filters on Nov 3 that let players filter not only by whether genAI was used but by where it was used — graphics, code, tools and more.
items.note: feature angle; overlaps published aftermath itch terabytes (11-04) — curator check

items.title: itch.io will soon let you filter games with genAI disclosures out of your search results on the site, after admitting it was previously "critically lacking"
items.excerpt: Following an exponential increase in uploads due to genAI use, itch.io is adding site-wide genAI disclosures and filters.
items.note: same story as Automaton itch filter — pick at most one; overlaps published itch items

items.title: 生成AIを使わない“人の手で作ったゲーム”を集めた世界規模のインディーゲームショーケース「Games Without AI」始動！11月25日配信へ
items.excerpt: Dev Land Marketing launches 'Games Without AI', a global showcase of indie games made without generative AI in art, music or voice, streaming Nov 25 alongside a Steam event; studios later found using AI are removed and barred.

items.title: Roblox growth slumps, but the company is betting big on AI
items.excerpt: Roblox missed its daily-active-user goals in Q3 but laid out plans to lean on AI creation tools to compensate.

items.title: Roblox developers use AI to port exact replicas of Elden Ring, Counter-Strike, Sonic Generations
items.excerpt: Creators are using AI-assisted tools to rebuild near-exact copies of Elden Ring, Counter-Strike and Sonic Generations inside Roblox; many have since been taken down.
items.note: off-list; AI clone wave on UGC platform

items.title: 'Low-Quality Goods' — Masahiro Sakurai Shrugs Off AI Games as 'Unprofitable Titles' as Clones and Mods Boom
items.excerpt: Smash Bros creator Masahiro Sakurai says the boom in AI-made games won't create lasting demand, likening them to low-quality goods that can't compare with human-made titles like Shadow of the Colossus.
